conflicts.claim_a: Model A states eight structured deliverables were attached.
conflicts.claim_b: The uploaded DOCX contains only broken links; no structured files were separately supplied.
conflicts.resolution: Reconstructed a new dataset from report text and underlying sources. The original CSV provenance cannot be audited.

conflicts.claim_a: Model B presents a top-down ownership map.
conflicts.claim_b: Model B explicitly states that Model A’s input files were unavailable.
conflicts.resolution: Treat Model B as an independent lead set, not a merged or reconciled dataset.

conflicts.claim_a: Model B cites a Fox careers page for Precision’s Southern relationship.
conflicts.claim_b: Southern’s Precision acquisition and current brand evidence directly support the relationship.
conflicts.resolution: Rejected the mismatched citation and replaced it with direct primary evidence.

conflicts.claim_a: Model B cites FoxNews.com for Daniel’s ownership.
conflicts.claim_b: Southern’s acquisition archive and current Daniel’s brand page support the relationship.
conflicts.resolution: Rejected the unrelated citation and replaced it with direct primary evidence.

conflicts.claim_a: Southern currently lists Daniel’s as an Austin brand.
conflicts.claim_b: Consumer-facing routing and consolidation signals suggest the standalone brand may be partially merged.
conflicts.resolution: Counted as current-facing with a visible activity-status conflict; no separate active-location count is inferred.

conflicts.claim_a: Blackstone announced an agreement expected to close in first-half 2026.
conflicts.claim_b: No closing announcement was located by July 26, 2026; Odyssey is the last closed sponsor in the record.
conflicts.resolution: Current platform is Champions. Ultimate sponsor is marked pending/unresolved, not Blackstone-owned.

conflicts.claim_a: SAS article page renders a later year.
conflicts.claim_b: SAS chronological news index places the transaction on October 3, 2023.
conflicts.resolution: Used 2023-10-03 and preserved the CMS date conflict.

conflicts.claim_a: SAS article page renders a later year.
conflicts.claim_b: SAS chronological news index places the transaction on June 7, 2024.
conflicts.resolution: Used 2024-06-07 and preserved the CMS date conflict.

conflicts.claim_a: SAS article page renders a later year.
conflicts.claim_b: SAS chronological news index places the transaction on July 20, 2024.
conflicts.resolution: Used 2024-07-20 and preserved the CMS date conflict.

conflicts.claim_a: Model A-style census logic could count Cool Atmosphere as a separate active Austin brand.
conflicts.claim_b: Current brand routing presents it within Austin Air Conditioning.
conflicts.resolution: Removed it from the active-brand denominator and retained it as a historical absorbed brand.

conflicts.claim_a: Current Ja-Mar site uses local-owner/local-company language.
conflicts.claim_b: Dunes Point Capital states that its platform acquired Ja-Mar in April 2025.
conflicts.resolution: Classified as sponsor-backed. “Local” wording is treated as operating/management language unless equity documentation says otherwise.

conflicts.claim_a: Model B treated KKR/Cortec control allocation as unresolved.
conflicts.claim_b: Groundworks and Cortec materials establish KKR control/majority and Cortec minority retention.
conflicts.resolution: Updated to KKR majority/control, Cortec minority.

conflicts.claim_a: A generic PE-backed label could imply Trivest control.
conflicts.claim_b: Trivest explicitly calls the investment minority and non-control, with founders retaining control.
conflicts.resolution: Classified separately as minority-invested, founder-controlled.

conflicts.claim_a: Model A excluded the company as too generic/directory-dependent.
conflicts.claim_b: Current official, BBB, and founder evidence supports a real Austin operator.
conflicts.resolution: Reversed the exclusion and added the brand with named-owner evidence.

conflicts.claim_a: Massey acquired EcoShield’s Austin division in 2015.
conflicts.claim_b: A current EcoShield-branded Austin branch is active, but the present legal/operator chain is not disclosed.
conflicts.resolution: Recorded the 2015 transaction as historical only; current EcoShield ownership remains unresolved.

conflicts.claim_a: One current business profile identifies Mark Lipscomb as president/director.
conflicts.claim_b: Other public professional references identify a different person as owner.
conflicts.resolution: Do not publish an individual controller until state/entity records resolve the conflict.

conflicts.claim_a: PCM Growth acquired Hawx in 2021.
conflicts.claim_b: No sufficiently current direct portfolio or closing-chain source was found for July 2026.
conflicts.resolution: Retain PCM as the last documented sponsor, but classify current control as unresolved.

conflicts.claim_a: Franchisor ownership by Apax/BCI is clear.
conflicts.claim_b: Local Austin franchisee legal entity and owner are not established by strong current sources.
conflicts.resolution: Separate franchisor ownership from local operator; leave franchisee unresolved.

conflicts.claim_a: Model B relied on a transaction database for Riverside’s investment.
conflicts.claim_b: Current Radiant terms, T3, and Riverside pages provide direct evidence.
conflicts.resolution: Replaced the secondary database with primary sources.

conflicts.claim_a: Review counts, permits, branch pages, and search visibility can look like size measures.
conflicts.claim_b: No comparable revenue, jobs, or customer denominator exists across all brands.
conflicts.resolution: All reported percentages are brand-record shares within the reconstructed publication universe, never market share.
